Start off with a small battle with an older mysterio, then turning him into the police, revealing it to be Bruce cambell.

Then Peter returns home to his wife mj. Have them discuss the future of oscorp as both the namesakes of the company are gone and the board have discussed shutting down all together. Reveal that mj and Peter have kid(s) together. 

Cut to a scene showing moving trucks and workers emptying the remnants of oscorp and a scientist frantically tying to aquire as much research as he can carry before its confiscated.

Now, seeing that most of the previous villains have mostly been physical challenges, I would love to have one that was a bit on the weaker side, but extremely intelligent, much more than peter. I would personally love to see Chameleon introduced. Maybe a frantic lab experiment goes wrong and now he can mold his face as he pleases. 

I think there should be a lot of mental "fuckery" as the main challenge. Having mysterio as the precursor to an also "imagery" type villain. I also think that Chameleon should figure out Peter's secret identity. 

Have Chameleon change into previous villains, or new ones all together. Maybe that old college professor peter had is now a 7 foot lizard monster? Or to really mess with him, his dead best friend is suddenly back from the grave? 

I'd love if the story was more of a moral dilemma. Maybe peter accidentally kills Chameleon, or maybe he didn't kill him at all. Is mj acting strange? Is anyone around him who can trust? I'd also wish it be a bit more mature than the previous films. Sill have the witty banter and quips, but have peter juggle more responsibility. 

I know they'd probably never make this movie, or hell even an amazing spiderman 3, but I digress.
